messages:
chloe_support: FYI customer FinWave seeing 429s every minute since 08:40 UTC, started ~30m ago. They report ~3k req/min spikes for short bursts, mostly POST /v1/generate (non-stream).
ben_oncall: Thanks — can you paste a sample request-id + headers from the failed responses? especially X-RateLimit and Retry-After if present.
chloe_support: Got one from their logs: request_id=finwave-req-21a4, response headers:
```
X-RateLimit-Limit: 600/min
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 161
Retry-After: 60
```
chloe_support: They say clients retry with linear 1s backoff which piles up at minute boundary.
alice_sre: That header set shows per-minute window (600/min). If they burst more than 600 in a minute the remaining will drop to 0 and Retry-After will cause synchronized retries.
alice_sre: Quick mitigation: advise FinWave to randomize/backoff jitter and use exponential backoff; alternatively we can provision a temporary quota increase or enable burst smoothing on their Dedicated pool.
chloe_support: Customer asked for immediate hotfix while they push a client change. Any temporary server-side mitigations?
ben_oncall: We can enable short-lived grace tokens (smooth window) for FinWave for the next hour — gives ~20% buffer for minute spikes. I'll need customer org id and confirm billing is ok.
chloe_support: Org id 11578-finwave, billing contact confirmed. Can you enable smoothing and monitor?
ben_oncall: On it. Also flagging config we should check: their requests are non-streaming which increases RPM cost; ask if they can switch to streaming or reduce token length.
alice_sre: For long term: recommend rate-limiter advisory: shift to sliding-window token bucket, add jittered retry examples, and add client-side concurrency limits. I'll open an internal ticket to propose a console toggle for smoothing per-tenant.
rate-bot: Automation: increased minute quota by +150 for org 11578-finwave for 60 minutes (actioned by ben_oncall). Monitor metrics: watch error-rate and p50/p95 latency. :white_check_mark:
chloe_support: Sent customer note: temporary buffer added, please deploy client patch with jitter/backoff and report after next hour. :thumbsup:
ben_oncall: Follow-up: collect spans from their failing requests if they reoccur (trace header x-redwood-trace) so we can verify queueing vs immediate rejects.
chloe_support: Will request trace header logs and follow up here.
